tasks.title: Replace hand-built nav href with IURLGenerator::linkToRoute
tasks.description: In AppNavigationService::registerNavEntries (~line 185), replace $appUrl = '/apps/openbuild/builder/'.$slug; with $this->urlGenerator->linkToRoute('openbuild.dashboard.builder', ['slug' => $slug]); using the existing urlGenerator dependency (same pattern as the icon URL two lines above).
acceptance_criteria: Nav entry href is produced by linkToRoute('openbuild.dashboard.builder', ...), not a hand-built string
Resolves correctly on both front-controller-required (/index.php) and rewrite-enabled instances

tasks.title: Test nav href comes from linkToRoute
tasks.description: Extend tests/Unit/Service/AppNavigationServiceTest.php with a case that mocks IURLGenerator::linkToRoute to return a distinctive /index.php-including value for route openbuild.dashboard.builder and asserts the registered closure's href equals it, not a hand-built string.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts the closure's returned href equals the mocked linkToRoute value

tasks.title: Inject Application authoritative name into getManifest
tasks.description: In ApplicationsController::getManifest (~line 250, alongside injectOwnerSignal), inject the Application's authoritative name field as the manifest's top-level name so the served manifest always carries the cased display name regardless of the stored manifest blob's own name value.
acceptance_criteria: getManifest response top-level name equals the Application's name field even when the stored blob's name is missing or stale

tasks.title: Test getManifest name authority
tasks.description: Create tests/Unit/Controller/ApplicationsControllerTest.php asserting getManifest returns name 'Pet Store' when the Application name is 'Pet Store' but the stored manifest blob name is missing or stale ('pet-store').
acceptance_criteria: New test asserts the response name reflects the Application name, not the stale blob name

tasks.title: Verify via host phpunit
tasks.description: Run OPENBUILD_SKIP_NC_BOOTSTRAP=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-unit.xml on the host (out of container, PHP 8.3) and confirm the new/extended cases and the full unit suite pass.
acceptance_criteria: Full unit suite passes with no regressions
